name: Vienna Secession gold

influenced_by: a breakaway from Vienna's conservative official art academy

garments: not a fashion look — painting, architecture and graphic design
reacts_against: the conservative Vienna Künstlerhaus's academic taste; the group's 1897 split (hence "Secession") championed a more decorative, gold-leaf-and-pattern-heavy modern style, summarized by their motto "To every age its art, to art its freedom."

findings: a vivid streak — roughly 32% of the color measured is highly saturated
mostly muted — about 57% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
